prior_coverage: A unique Brownian first-passage crossover for every static diffusivity mixture (2026-11-08) already establishes universal one-CDF/two-density crossing counts and the strict bracket; those statements are excluded from novelty.
scientific_contribution: Distribution-independent limiting positions of the two density crossings and one CDF crossing, and the limiting common absorption probability; global crossing counts and time brackets were proved earlier.
scientific_limitations: No finite-epsilon distribution-free locations or higher-order corrections.
No result for time-fluctuating diffusivity, unbounded Z or changing comparator mean.
scientific_scope: Brownian first passage to an absorbing half-line endpoint; quenched bounded centered nondegenerate perturbations D_epsilon=mu(1+epsilon Z); epsilon down to zero with fixed x,mu.
title: Universal weak-disorder crossing times for quenched Brownian first passage
